subject: math
description: Solve multi-step geometry problems by choosing and justifying area and circumference formulas for composite situations.
learningObjectives: Identify when a problem asks for area, circumference, or both
Choose the correct formula for rectangles, triangles, circles, semicircles, and circular paths
Solve multi-step area and circumference problems using organized work
Justify each selected formula using the meaning of the measurement
Check answers for reasonable units and common radius-diameter errors
